texts.zh:
我们对结晶熵的掌控即将开启星系激变。已开通连接星系核心6个恒星系的虫洞。
若在各恒星系建立导管群设施，并守护免受干涉，我们即可燃烧整个星系。
texts.en:
Our mastery of Crystallized Entropy will soon allow us to begin a radical transformation of the galaxy. We have opened wormholes to six systems around the galactic core.
If we establish Conduits in each of these, and defend them from anyone who would meddle with our plans, we will be able to set the galaxy itself ablaze.

texts.zh:
对立帝国已强行开启通往我们靠近星系核心集结地的超空间航路。随着我们持续使核心超热，必须为抵抗做好准备。

但我们不会被阻止。宇宙中寒冷黑暗将被驱散，取而代之的是我们崛起未来的炽热辉煌。
texts.en:
Rival empires have forced open hyperlanes to our staging grounds near the galactic core. As we continue to superheat the core, we must prepare for resistance.

But we will not be stopped. The cold dark of space will be scoured away, replaced by the blazing glory of our ascendant future.

label.zh: 他们永远无法扑灭我们。
label.en: They will never snuff us out.

label.zh: 让他们前赴后继于熊熊烈焰中吧。
label.en: Let them hurl themselves into our incinerating blaze.

texts.zh:
星系核心开始躁动。环绕超大质量黑洞的熵水平激增，向附近恒星系释放出热辐射波动。

正当恐慌蔓延时，一支由多星球勇敢科学家组成的小组揭示了连接核心周边六个恒星系的新近超空间航路。这些恒星系据悉拥有由[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]运作的设施，正在积极使核心过热。这种鲁莽干预将引发星系级火风暴，将毁灭所有未能阻止纵火狂野心的人。

若想生存，我们必须突破这些恒星系，夺取控制权。危机已至——温度仍在攀升。
texts.en:
The galactic core has begun to stir. Entropy levels around the supermassive black hole are spiking, casting waves of thermal radiation into nearby systems.

Just as panic sets in, a team of brave scientists, drawn from many worlds, has unveiled newly-formed hyperlanes connecting to six systems encircling the core. These systems, it seems, house facilities operated by [hyperthermia_empire.GetName], which are actively superheating the core. This reckless tampering threatens to ignite a cascading firestorm across the galaxy, incinerating all who fail to stop their pyromaniac ambitions.

If we wish to survive, we must breach these systems and wrest control from their grasp. The crisis is here—and the temperature is still rising.

texts.zh:
历史上伟大变革常伴随牺牲。然而，星海共同体将我方的工作视为不必要的威胁，并以联合军事同盟名义对我们动员。

其目标直指灭绝，我们别无选择：任何接近星系核心或星系熔炉的行为都会遭到压倒性武力的回应。

我们的愿景已点燃恒星。让反对者迎战我们召唤的风暴吧。

守住星系核心恒星系，我们就一定能取得胜利！
texts.en:
History's greatest transformations have always demanded sacrifice. Yet the Galactic Community views our work as a threat rather than a necessity. In response, a unified military coalition has mobilized against us.

With extermination their stated goal, we are left with no alternative: any approach toward the Galactic Core or the Galactic Crucible will be met with overwhelming force.

Our vision has ignited the stars themselves. Let those who oppose it contend with the storm we have summoned.

Defend the Galactic Core systems and our victory is assured!

texts.zh:
鉴于星系核心局势升级威胁，星海共同体联合采取行动反对[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]，其激进加热星系行为威胁所有已知生命。

若任其为所欲为，无数文明将陷灭绝危机。所谓[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]已与必要联合的联盟成直接对立。

战斗已发动，数万亿生命岌岌可危。

夺取星系核心恒星系，否则将失去一切！
texts.en:
In light of escalating threats at the galactic core, the Galactic Community has enacted a unified response against [hyperthermia_empire.GetName], whose radical efforts to raise the galactic temperature endanger all known life.

Should these ambitions proceed unchecked, countless civilizations face extinction. The so-called [hyperthermia_empire.GetName] now stands in direct opposition to a coalition united by necessity.

The battle has begun, and trillions of lives hang in the balance.

Capture the Galactic Core systems or all will be lost!
